item.title: Infineon acquires C2i Semiconductors to boost AI data center power portfolio
item.summary: Infineon Technologies is acquiring Bangalore-based C2i Semiconductors to strengthen its power management portfolio for AI data centers. The deal will add expertise in software-defined multiphase controllers, smart power stages and vertical power delivery architectures, with completion expected in the third quarter of 2026.
